## Acceptance criteria

REQ-01 fails. The projected lock timeout is not the sole runtime default: claim commands still construct `FileLocker` with literal five-second timeouts, so changing `LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECS` does not update all operational lock behavior.

REQ-02 fails. The worktree coordination tutorial retains an unchecked default-TTL copy.

REQ-03 is otherwise covered by the committed-reference conformance test.

## Architecture and separation of concerns

The new projection remains pure and does not introduce domain/storage/CLI boundary violations.

## Functional paradigm

No new blocking concerns.

## Correctness and invariants

Atomic rename is now used by the ignored regeneration test. No unsafe or PID-related changes were introduced.

## Testing

Recorded `cargo-ci` passed for the current commit; I did not rerun Cargo tests. `docs-mechanical` passed. `./scripts/jit-validate.sh` passed.

## Error handling and CLI contract

No new blocking concerns. Existing JSON command support is unaffected.

## Documentation

The prior findings about the heartbeat alias, claim-reference links, navigation, atomic regeneration, and public docs on the new runtime-default APIs are addressed. The remaining documentation default below can still drift.

## JIT issue management

The sole dependency (`6d82de03`) is done; repository validation passes.

## Findings

1. **High** — `LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECS` is presented as the source-defined lock timeout, but production claim operations retain independent `Duration::from_secs(5)` values (for example [claim.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs:130), also at lines 219, 364, 466, 535, 603, 657, 730, and 784). This violates REQ-01’s single maintained source: updating the projection constant and regenerating its reference leaves those claim lock timeouts unchanged.

2. **Medium** — [parallel-work-worktrees.md](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/docs/tutorials/parallel-work-worktrees.md:119) independently states the default lease TTL is ten minutes without linking to, or being mechanically checked against, `runtime-defaults.md`. That duplicate can drift when `CLAIM_TTL_SECS` changes, failing REQ-02.

Total findings: 2
